answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 15008 Country: India Title: I dreamt that my whole family (in-laws )was having breakfast and everybody was eating eggs. Everybody's egg yolks were yellow in color except mine which was blue in color. Can you please be able to let know the meaning of this dream if any. Rest Allah knows everything better. Question: I dreamt that my whole family (in-laws )was having breakfast and everybody was eating eggs. Everybody's egg yolks were yellow in color except mine which was blue in color. Can you please be able to let know the meaning of this dream if any. Rest Allah knows everything better. Answer ID: 15008 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1706/1372=H/1430) The dream indicates that your in-laws have sincere relations with you, but you lack the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
